intent.redeem.title: Opens Tada
intent.redeem.body: Clicking this button will take you to Tada, the rewards store, where you spend your coins on gifts and vouchers.
intent.reward.title: Opens this reward in Tada
intent.reward.body: Clicking this button will open this reward's page in Tada, where you can redeem it with your coins.
intent.trade.title: Opens the market
intent.trade.body: Clicking this button will open the market screen in the app with your current trading account.
intent.trade-account.title: Opens the market
intent.trade-account.body: Clicking this button will open the market screen in the app and switch to trading account {account}.
intent.kyc.title: Opens identity verification
intent.kyc.body: Clicking this button will open the KYC screen in the app. Once you are verified, you can join the trading task.
intent.deposit.title: Opens Deposit
intent.deposit.body: Clicking this button will open the Deposit screen in the app. After your first deposit, you can join the trading task.
intent.checkin.title: Checks you in
intent.checkin.body: Clicking this button will mark today as checked in and add today's coins to your balance.
intent.exit.title: Leaves HSB Loyalty
intent.exit.body: Clicking this button will close these pages and take you back to the app.
